# Neo-brutalism

Direct, graphic, and unapologetically clear.

## Use

Use for bold internal campaigns, creative tools, and memorable learning cards.

## Essential traits

- Hard offset shadow
- Thick visible borders
- Direct bold typography

## Typography

Bold system sans-serif headlines with sturdy body type.

## Layout and surfaces

Strong boxes, explicit labels, and clear hierarchy. Heavy dark borders, hard offset shadows, bright pastel accents.

## Palette

- background: #f3f1e5
- surface: #fffef7
- text: #22251f
- muted: #565c4e
- accent: #614e94
- border: #22251f

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Neo-brutalism to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Bold system sans-serif headlines with sturdy body type. Strong boxes, explicit labels, and clear hierarchy. Heavy dark borders, hard offset shadows, bright pastel accents. Palette: background #f3f1e5, surface #fffef7, text #22251f, muted #565c4e, accent #614e94, border #22251f. Essential traits: Hard offset shadow; Thick visible borders; Direct bold typography. Avoid: Decoration that obscures affordance; Uncontrolled visual noise; Color-only controls. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
